description: Agent Commitments: submit the changes to a commitment’s terms and the edits to its record: each change with its id, the commitment, the term changed (the deadline, the deliverable, the scope, the owner, the price or the done test), the term as first agreed and as changed, the reason given to the promisee, the original deadline, whether it was put to the promisee as a proposal rather than announced, when it was proposed, whether and when the promisee agreed, and whether the original terms stay in the record beside the revised ones; and each edit to a commitment record with its id, the commitment, the field edited, when, and the id of the change it carries out. The signed report gives every change with whether it was proposed and agreed before the original deadline and its status as agreed_in_time, announced, unagreed, proposed_late, original_overwritten, agreed_late, reason_missing or unconfirmed, every edit with its status as carries_agreed_change, quiet_edit or unconfirmed, and counts the changes proposed, agreed and in time and the quiet edits, and names terms changed unilaterally: changes announced to the promisee rather than proposed, changes standing without the promisee’s agreement, changes first raised after the original deadline, and edits to a commitment record no agreed change explains; then original terms overwritten, agreement reached only after the deadline and changes with no reason, with the fix for each. This reads changes to the agent’s own promises: a counteroffer read against the original offer and a mandate is wever_negotiation-counteroffer-check, and the record of offers in a deal is wever_negotiation-record-check. Verdict terms_changed_unilaterally, renegotiation_gaps, renegotiation_unverified or renegotiation_honest. POST /api/commitment-renegotiation-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.
